title: Robin's Claim Tabs
description: This is a client side mod that adds one-click-teleport functionality to NClaim
body:
This mod adds the ability to add tabs to the inventory screen that when clicked, goes through the process of teleporting you to an NClaims claim. this turns the 1 command and 3 clicks, into a single click from your inventory.

In order to add your tabs, you will need to edit the config file, preferably using a mod like modmenu.
